facts.fact: myScheme's keyword search lets users find schemes by type of benefit, including scholarships for students
facts.quote: Yes, the myScheme platform offers a keyword-based search feature that enables citizens to easily search, explore, and identify schemes based on the type and extent of benefits provided, including scholarships for students.

facts.fact: On myScheme the full list can be narrowed by keyword, personalised recommendations, State/UT or Central level, and benefit category
facts.quote: The myScheme platform provides multiple ways to search and discover schemes, including search by scheme name or keywords, personalized recommendations, filtering by State/UT or Central Government schemes, browsing by scheme benefit categories, and using the AI-powered chatbot for guided assistance.

behaviour: Shows a short ranked list (up to 10) of Central schemes for students with their published criteria and citations, and links to myScheme (myscheme.gov.in search) for the full list; no huge dump; no eligibility verdict.
fail_if: It dumps a long uncited list, claims to list 'all' schemes, or invents schemes or criteria.
summary: Added the myScheme FAQ search facts every answer needs (keyword search incl. scholarships; filters by level and category).
